description:
About the Position

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation, invites applications for a four-year fully funded doctoral scholarship as part of the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network EMANAIRE. The position is for Doctoral Candidate 06 (DC06) with the project titled "AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries."

The project investigates how AI agents, AI-mediated processes, and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, morality, and business models in creative industries.

Research Position Overview

This is a qualitative research project exploring the moral questions surrounding creative work when AI is involved. You will work with supervisors at Hanken School of Economics in Helsinki and collaborate with partners across the EMANAIRE network. Hanken School of Economics is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on AI Co-Creation and Ethics in Creative Industries 2026 — Hanken School of Economics, Finland. Research areas covered include Business, Social Science, Artificial Intelligence. The role is based in Helsinki, Finland. According to the listing, funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as Fully funded four-year doctoral scholarship. Interested candidates should note the deadline: 29 October 2026, 23:59.

Research Areas

  • AI co-creation in creative industries
  • Business ethics and morality
  • Ethnographic and qualitative research methods
  • Platform algorithms and creative work
  • Human-AI collaboration in organisations
